name: rex
title: Rex backend
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Use Rex (Superlogical's multiplexer) as a terminal backend. Optional; needs Rex installed.
description: Runs vqro-rex and exposes Rex terminals as resources: live output, a screen repaint on attach, input, resize, exit codes and stored program status. By default it starts a separate vqro-owned Rex server under vqro's state directory; with --rex-socket it uses an existing Rex server (yours) and never starts or stops it. Turning it off disconnects the provider, not the Rex server or its programs; stop the owned server with vqro-rex server stop. Rex is proprietary alpha software, installed separately. Rex has no per-terminal environment (a spawn with env is refused) and takes text (UTF-8) input only.

commands: Provider operations: spawn, kill, attach, resize and supported terminal operations
